title: FabricSewn
description: Fabric Sewn is a performance‑focused Fabric modpack that combines FPS-boosting optimizations, immersive visuals, enhanced animations, and creative tools, along with new foods, quality-of-life improvements, and automation mods for a smoother, more engaging
body:
**🌿 Fabric Sewn**

Fabric Sewn is a curated, performance‑forward Fabric modpack that brings together powerful optimization, smooth visuals, enhanced gameplay tweaks, and creative tools — all in one experience. Designed for players who want better performance, more immersion, and expanded systems without losing the core feel of Minecraft.
**

**⚡ Optimization & Smooth Gameplay****

Experience a much smoother game with performance‑focused mods that take your FPS and stability to the next level:

Sodium & Sodium Extra – major FPS and rendering improvements

Lithium & Entity Culling – intelligent optimization under the hood

Chunky & Voxy – faster world streaming and rendering

Reese’s Sodium Options – customizable performance tweaks

**🎮 Visual & Immersion Enhancements**

Enjoy a more immersive world with better visuals, interactive sounds, and refined animations:

Ambient Sounds & Enhanced Audio/Ambience

Iris Shaders + Photon (Voxy compatible)

Continuity & Model Gap Fix – improved block and item visuals

Not Enough Animations & Fresh Animations

Colourful Containers & Better Lanterns (Resource Packs)

**📊 Utility & QoL Features**

Make Minecraft more intuitive with useful quality‑of‑life additions:

AppleSkin – food info at a glance

Better Mount HUD & Better Statistics

Hold My Items, Chest Tracker, Shulker Ender Chest Tooltips

Client Sort, World Playtime, World Edit

**🛠️ Expanded Gameplay**

Add new layers of playstyle and creativity:

Create Fly – flying tools from the Create ecosystem

Vein Miner & Wide Mining – efficient block harvesting

Fresh Food – tasty new culinary variety

Just Enough Items & Jade – insight into recipes and loot

**Note: This pack includes third‑party mods, resource packs, and shaders. All included content remains under its original license and is used according to Modrinth’s modpack permissions.**
